artifact_kind: implementation specification, not a native flow export

body.actor_id: actual authenticated approval responder object ID

expiry: 300 second signature window; approval workflow expires after 3 days
replay: same event and body returns already_processed; changed body with reused event ID is rejected
approval_control: flow approval assigned only to approver_id; map actual responder identity, never caller-supplied display name
escalation: scheduled authorised job invokes /v1/workflows/maintenance/expire; administrator reviews and renews expired requests
